thread:
Sasha Miller: Heads-up: embargo lifts 09:00 ET tomorrow for the benchmark blog. We have a short embargoed list (25 reporters). Need final verification on who gets the advanced package.
Diego Alvarez: I exported the reporter list to Google Drive: /press/embargo/package_v3.xlsx. Marked "certified" journalists in column F. Recommend sending the advanced package only to certified plus analyst contacts.
Nora Shah: Advanced package includes: full blog draft, benchmark appendix PDF, raw latency tables, and a demo gif. Any objections?
Ethan Brooks: Demo gif ok. Note: raw latency tables contain machine IDs, scrub those first. I can run a scrub script, ETA 07:30 ET.
Maya Kapoor: Legal flagged two lines in the appendix that read like guarantees. Reworded to "observed in our tests" in the latest appendix. Uploaded at 07:40 ET.
Sasha Miller: Thanks. Press email timing proposal: send reporter email at T-5 min before embargo with live link placeholder, then update at T+0 with live URL. That way no accidental previews. Thoughts?
Diego Alvarez: Agree. We'll use a shortlink that resolves after push. Setup: press-gateway.redwood.ai/launch -> redirects to live article after 09:00 ET. I'll coordinate with infra.
press-monitor-bot: Press gateway shortlink created: https://press-gateway.redwood.ai/launch (scheduled redirect at 09:00 ET). Healthcheck will run every 10s from 08:55 ET to 09:05 ET.
Nora Shah: Email subject + snippet are ready. Putting template here for review: ```Subject: Redwood Inference launches Optimize; embargo 09:00 ET [embargoed]
Snippet: Observed improvements in inference latency and cost. Full details attached for embargoed preview.```
Ethan Brooks: Small ask: include a one-line guidance in the email asking reporters not to publish until 09:00 ET. Some will ignore but it's standard.
Maya Kapoor: Also include an erratum policy line: "If you spot discrepancies, please reply to press@redwood.inference and we'll investigate promptly."
Sasha Miller: Social cadence: organic at T+12, thread explainer at T+20, paid at T+30. We'll hold the CEO quote until T+15 to give reporters breathing room.
Diego Alvarez: I'm standing by to hit send on the embargo package at 08:55 ET (T-5). Will batch-send via MailerPro to the certified list.
press-monitor-bot: Monitoring plan set: (1) webhook to #marketing for publish event, (2) media crawl every 5m for matches, (3) sentiment/diff check against embargoed copy at T+30 and T+120. Alerts to triage if mismatch.
Sasha Miller: What is the quick-fix plan if a reporter publishes early?
Maya Kapoor: If early publish happens, we (1) send polite reminder to reporter, (2) pull forward social to T0 if it's a major outlet, (3) notify sales and support to expect lift in traffic. Legal to advise on takedown requests if necessary.
Ethan Brooks: I'll prepare a patched appendix (v3.1) in case we need to correct numbers quickly. Keep it at /press/embargo/patches.
Nora Shah: Design note: if we need to reissue assets, have the OG image variants ready (square + wide). I uploaded alt and both sizes to the folder.
Diego Alvarez: Quick checklist for tomorrow morning: 07:30 scrub tables -> Ethan, 07:40 legal final -> Maya, 08:30 design confirm -> Nora, 08:55 send embargo package -> Diego, 09:00 publish -> commops-bot.
commops-bot: Scheduled publish task created: blog:benchmark-launch (v4.0.0) -> prod at 09:00:00 ET. Will post live URL to #marketing and ping @Sasha Miller.
Sasha Miller: Perfect. I'll run the post-publish monitor sweep at T+15. Everyone please be on standby 08:50-09:30 ET. :v:
